其二，阅读者可能会选择直接越过“亲自阅读”的艰苦，将所有要阅读的材料上传到一个大: Second, readers may choose to bypass the hardship of 'personal reading' entirely by uploading all materials to be read to a large language model and then waiting for a highly condensed 'summary' or 'opinion synthesis.'
其三，我们无法仅凭人工智能获得理解力、判断力和想象力，也无法形成基于自身独特阅读: Third, we cannot develop comprehension, judgment, and imagination solely through artificial intelligence, nor can we form perspectives based on our own unique reading experiences and life experiences.
人工智能时代，重提严肃阅读和深度理解，就是重提心灵与精神的重要性: In the age of artificial intelligence, re-emphasizing serious reading and deep understanding is to re-emphasize the importance of the mind and spirit.

AI客服为何成了“拦路虎”（商海观潮）: Why Has AI Customer Service Become a 'Roadblock' (Commercial Tide Watch)
问AI（人工智能）客服A问题，AI客服却回答B问题: Ask an AI (artificial intelligence) customer service representative question A, and the AI customer service responds with answer B.
不会实际操作，想问怎么解决，AI客服只会反复念说明书: Don't know how to actually operate something and want to ask how to solve it, yet the AI customer service only repeatedly recites the manual.
情况紧急，AI客服却不紧不慢地绕圈子，各种菜单选项来回切换，就是不提供转人工的选: When the situation is urgent, the AI customer service takes its time going in circles, switching back and forth through various menu options without ever offering the option to transfer to a human agent... For a long time, 'answering the wrong question,' 'repeatedly going in circles,' and 'difficulty transferring to a human' have been the feelings many consumers have toward AI customer service.
如今，打开各种APP，不知不觉中原本的人工客服已经普遍换成“AI客服”“客服机器: Nowadays, opening various apps, one realizes that the original human customer service has been widely replaced with 'AI customer service,' 'customer service robots,' and 'intelligent customer service assistants.'
技术进步本是好事，AI客服能够提高服务效率、降低企业成本，但很多企业的AI客服却: Technological progress is inherently good—AI customer service can improve service efficiency and reduce enterprise costs—but many enterprises' AI customer service has become an obstacle to consumers obtaining service information, actually delaying resolution.
中国消费者协会发布的《2026年上半年全国消协组织受理投诉情况分析》显示，大约每: The 'Analysis of Complaint Acceptance by National Consumer Associations in the First Half of 2026' released by the China Consumer Association shows that roughly one out of every two complaints is service-related, and AI customer service is becoming consumers' most troublesome 'roadblock.'
分工要科学，简单的问题交给AI，复杂的纠纷要及时地流转到人工: Division of labor must be scientific—simple questions go to AI, while complex disputes must be promptly transferred to humans.
有了国家标准的规范和引导，AI客服也要培训“达标”才能更好地服务于消费者: With the standardization and guidance of national standards, AI customer service also needs to be trained to 'meet standards' to better serve consumers.
就像人工客服上岗前需要培训专业能力、沟通技巧、应变能力等一样，经营者也要建立AI: Just as human customer service representatives need training in professional competence, communication skills, and adaptability before taking their posts, operators must also establish 'onboarding' and testing mechanisms for AI customer service. Before going online, AI customer service must undergo sufficient business rule training and sandbox testing to ensure its responses comply with the enterprise's actual policies and do not make unauthorized commitments.
经营者也不能简单以“AI回答不代表公司立场”“算法生成内容不具备法律效力”等理由: Operators also cannot simply refuse to fulfill commitments on the grounds that 'AI responses do not represent the company's position' or 'algorithm-generated content lacks legal effect.' The standard clearly states that 'customer contact centers should view human customer service and intelligent customer service as a complete service.'
近年来，我国在人工智能治理和消费者权益保护领域持续完善管理举措: In recent years, China has continuously improved management measures in artificial intelligence governance and consumer rights protection.
从2023年施行《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》，到2025年发布《移动互联网: From the implementation of the 'Temporary Measures for the Management of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services' in 2023, to the release of the 'Mobile Internet Application Service User Rights Protection Compliance Management Guidelines' in 2025.
从今年7月施行《人工智能拟人化互动服务管理暂行办法》，再到此次实施《顾客联络服务: From the implementation of the Interim Measures for the Management of Anthropomorphic Interactive Services of Artificial Intelligence in July this year, to the current implementation of the Requirements for Collaboration between Human and Intelligent Customer Service in Customer Contact Services, a series of measures continue to improve the artificial intelligence governance system. These measures not only help promote the entire industry's upgrade toward standardization, intelligence, and humanization, and provide strong support for the healthy development of the digital services ecosystem, but also help continuously strengthen consumer rights protection

要把握人工智能发展趋势和规律，加紧制定完善相关法律法规、政策制度、应用规范、伦理: We must grasp the development trends and laws governing artificial intelligence, and promptly formulate and improve relevant laws and regulations, policies and systems, application norms, and ethical principles, so that technology grows more vigorously in the "soil" of institutions and better serves humanity
